issues.summary: Pacific Meridian voy 019N carrying container PSSU5173790 (40HC, MBL PSSU260111 / HBL MFCIM260003) was delayed 6 days due to port congestion at Shanghai, moving ETA Busan from 2026-01-28 to 2026-02-03, escalated as Severity 1 due to production risk for Daehan Precision.

Daehan Precision requested priority customs clearance for the industrial sensors in container PSSU5173790 on arrival in Busan because they are needed for production; release was obtained on 2026-02-04.

decisions.summary: Minseo Park decided to accept the 6-day delay without re-routing the cargo and to send Daehan Precision a daily ETA update until the vessel arrives in Busan.

tasks.summary: Send Daehan Precision a daily ETA update for HBL MFCIM260003 until the vessel arrives in Busan.
